newsitem.title: UK: Goldman says completes BP KIO share placing.
newsitem.headline: Goldman says completes BP KIO share placing.

text.p: Goldman Sachs on Thursday said it had completed the sale of three percent of shares in British Petroleum Co Plc, calling the block deal -- the largest ever undertaken -- a "huge success".
The shares, put up for sale by the Kuwait Investment Office (KIO), were sold at 716 pence per share to investors across the globe, a Goldman Sachs spokesman said. "It's been a huge success," he said.
"We have seen very strong demand worldwide," the Goldman spokesman said after the 1.22 billion pound BP deal.
"Goldman Sachs has again shown that it is really pre-eminent in this block trade industry," he added.
Goldman in February sold $732 million worth of shares in RJR Nabisco Holding Corp for U.S. financier Carl Icahn.
A month earlier, Goldman completed the $900 million sale of Guinness shares for LVMH Moet Hennesy Louis Vuitton.
KIO said late on Wednesday it wanted to sell the BP shares because its total 9.3 percent stake had become disproportionately big.
